title: Move it all out now
description: This city's troops at home, injured troops and resources can go to your other cities at once, shared evenly, and any heroes you choose. Armies out, queues and fortifications stay.
noCities: You have no other city to move to.
nothing: There is nothing left in this city to move.
underAttack: An enemy army is on its way to this city, so it can't be moved out.
cooldown: You kept a city you had moved out: you can move a city out again in <countdown />.
confirmDescription: This happens at once and can't be undone. If you then keep {{city}}, what moved doesn't come back, and you can't move any city out for {{time}}.
noRoom: None of your other cities has a free Feasting Hall slot.
